projects.title: Jobstreet Headless Bot
projects.problem: Manual job applications are time-consuming and inefficient.
projects.solution: Built a robust, provider-agnostic AI agent using litellm to automate applications with secure credential management.
projects.impact: Completely automated the job search pipeline with robust AI capability.

projects.title: AI Lead Qualifier Wrapper
projects.problem: Raw LLM integration in CRM lead qualification leads to unmanaged costs and data loss.
projects.solution: Architected a highly resilient FastAPI microservice featuring an SQLite Quota Engine and a Dead Letter Queue (DLQ).
projects.impact: Prevented API bankruptcy and ensured zero data loss on failed LLM calls.

projects.title: EduMetrics AI Pipeline
projects.problem: Basic async scripts failed under rate limits when generating educational feedback.
projects.solution: Rebuilt into a durable data processing pipeline powered by Prefect v3 with native exponential backoff and retries.
projects.impact: Processed thousands of student records concurrently with zero failures or data dropouts.

projects.title: Resilient n8n State Machine
projects.problem: Single-file workflow automation schemas are brittle and difficult to debug.
projects.solution: Deployed an enterprise-grade 3-tier architecture with global error catching, sub-workflow delegation, and native retry logic.
projects.impact: Transformed standard automation into a production-grade fault-tolerant state machine.
